en.review.vectra-ai.vectras.approach.priori: Vectra's approach prioritizes attacker behaviors over signatures, making it effective against novel and sophisticated attacks that evade traditional security tools.
en.review.vectra-ai.behavioral.ai.focuses.o: Behavioral AI focuses on attacker techniques rather than anomalies or signatures.
en.review.vectra-ai.deep.visibility.into.ne: Deep visibility into network traffic including encrypted communications.
